stem.text: Which formula represents an ester that will form propanoic acid on hydrolysis with dilute sulfuric acid?

A.alt: Skeletal ester: propanoate group (three carbons) bonded to O-ethyl (ethyl ester)

B.alt: Skeletal ester: branched acid group (methyl branch on the carbon next to C=O) with O-ethyl

C.alt: Skeletal ester: ethanoate group (two carbons) bonded to O-propyl

D.alt: Skeletal ester: butanoate group (four carbons) bonded to O-ethyl
